title: Both 547/727 prime-race moves finish by 400H through exp(12500)
description:
Both opposite dyadic changes greater than 1.9735 log 2 finish strictly before 400H after every real H between 1 and exp(12500) in the 547/727 prime-ideal race, unconditionally. This deposit preserves the source from the original GitHub release.

Proof and hypotheses. Original release.
